Validate POD5 read IDs

Source: R/read_pod5.R
dot-check_ids.Rd

Validates a vector of POD5 read identifiers and converts them to lowercase UUID strings.

Usage

.check_ids(read_ids)

Arguments

read_ids

character vector of read IDs in UUID format or 'NULL'

Value

a vector of validated 'read_ids' converted to lowercase or 'NULL'

Details

Each read ID must be a non-missing character string containing a valid UUID. Duplicate read IDs are not allowed.
